liberationAttacks.name: Resonance Liberation: A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers
liberationAttacks.description:
Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers
By reducing HP to 50% of the Max HP, Cartethyia transforms into Fleurdelys, unlocking new moves and entering the Manifest state for 12s.
Can be performed in mid-air.
Entering Manifest clears all Conviction.
As Fleurdelys, Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5, Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2, and Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides instantly trigger 1 instance of Aero Erosion DMG and reduce the Aero Erosion stack on the target hit by 1.
- Ending the state will not clear Resonance Energy.
- No HP cost when HP is below 50%.
Fleurdelys's attacks restore Conviction on hit. When Conviction reaches 120 points, press Resonance Liberation to cast Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall.
When Conviction is below 120 points, press Resonance Liberation to transform back into Cartethyia. When in Manifest, casting Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers as Cartethyia consumes no Resonance Energy.
When Fleurdelys has Heart of Virtue in Manifest:
- Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4 will generate a force field to Stagnate the targets within the range.
- Fleurdelys's resistance to interruption increases.
Heart of Virtue is removed when Manifest ends.
When Fleurdelys has Mandate of Divinity in Manifest:
Aero Erosion DMG is Amplified by 50% and the damage interval is decreased by 50% for enemies within a certain distance from Fleurdelys.
Mandate of Divinity is removed when Manifest ends.

When Fleurdelys has Power of Discord in Manifest:
When casting Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5, Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2 and Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys or after Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides deals damage, raise the Aero Erosion stacks on all nearby targets to the highest count among the targets.
Power of Discord is removed when Manifest ends.

Fleurdelys will transform back to Cartethyia during quest dialogues, environmental interaction animations, or using Utilities.
Fleurdelys can walk on water. Doing so on deep waters continuously consumes STA. When in walking state, Fleurdelys can step out of a high place and walk in mid-air by continuously consuming STA.

Avatar - Cartethyia
As Fleurdelys, when Conviction is below 120 points, press Resonance Liberation to perform Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2 and temporarily transform back to Cartethyia, which pauses the timer on Manifest.
Can be cast in mid-air. Casting the skill in mid-air performs Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia.

Avatar - Fleurdelys
When in Manifest, casting Resonance Liberation as Cartethyia performs Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2 without consuming Resonance Energy and transforms her back to Fleurdelys, which resumes the timer on Manifest.
Can be cast in mid-air. Casting this skill in mid-air performs Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 1.
Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall
When Fleurdelys has 120 points of Conviction, Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers is replaced by Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall.
Casting Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall removes all Conviction, ends Manifest, restores 50% of Max HP, and then deals Aero DMG to all targets in an area along a straight line in front. Upon hitting the target, remove all stacks of Aero Erosion on the target. Each stack removed Amplifies the DMG taken by the targets by 20%, up to 5 stacks.
Can be cast in mid-air.

forteCircuitAttacks.description:
Cartethyia unlocks new moves when she transforms into Fleurdelys:
Basic Attack - Fleurdelys
Basic Attack - Cartethyia is replaced by Basic Attack - Fleurdelys.
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit.
Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys
Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys.
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in the air at the cost of STA, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit.
While airborne, hold Normal Attack to cast Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3.
Follow up with Basic Attack shortly afterward to cast Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3.
While airborne, casting Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call and Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides resets the cycle of Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys.
Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys
Heavy Attack - Cartethyia is replaced by Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys.
Thrust forward to deliver a focused strike, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit. This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.
Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys
While casting Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys, press Normal Attack again to cast Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys: fall back and blast the area in a straight line in front, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit. This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.
Follow up with Basic Attack shortly after casting Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys to cast Upward Cut - Fleurdelys.
Upward Cut - Fleurdelys
While Fleurdelys is on the ground, Jump to cast this skill, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit.
Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys
Dodge Counter - Cartethyia is replaced by Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys.
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit.
Follow up with Basic Attack shortly afterward to cast Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4 .

Resonance Skill - Cartethyia is replaced by Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call.
Summon a force field near the target's location to continuously pull in nearby targets, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit.

Following Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call, press Resonance Skill again to call down a giant Sword Shadow to crush an area around the target, creating a force field to pull in nearby targets, dealing Aero DMG to ground targets, and restoring Conviction on hit.
Follow up with Basic Attack shortly afterward to cast Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3.
The Resonance Skill enters cooldown if Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides is not cast within a certain period or when switching to another Resonator.

forteCircuitAttacks.description:
Seraphic Duo
When casting Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 4 or Basic Attack - Mech Stage 4, enter Seraphic Duo for 5s.

Resonance Skill - Seraphic Duet: Overture
When Aemeath is in Seraphic Duo and the Synchronization Rate is no less than 100 points, press Resonance Skill to cast Resonance Skill Seraphic Duet: Overture at the cost of 100 points of Synchronization Rate, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air.
Switch into the Mech form after casting this skill and exit Seraphic Duo. Press Normal Attack within a certain period of time to cast Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2.

Resonance Skill - Seraphic Duet: Encore
In the Mech form, when in Seraphic Duo and the Synchronization Rate is no less than 100 points, press Resonance Skill to cast Resonance Skill Seraphic Duet: Encore at the cost of 100 points of Synchronization Rate, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air.
Switch back to Aemeath and exit the Seraphic Duo state. Press Normal Attack shortly afterward to cast Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2.

Resonance Mode
- In Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture, when Resonators in the team respond to Tune Rupture - Interfered, inflict 10 stacks of Rupturous Trail on the target for 30s, stacking up to 30 times.

- In Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, when Resonators in the team inflict Fusion Burst, inflict 1 stack of Fusion Trail for 30s, stacking up to 30 times.
While in combat, when the Fusion Burst on targets near the active Resonator reaches 0 stacks, inflict 1 stack of Fusion Burst. If the targets have more than 5 stacks of Fusion Burst, trigger Fusion Burst based on their max stack limit and remove all of their stacks.

In Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture/Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, inflict Tune Rupture - Shifting/Fusion Burst when the following skills deal damage. The same skill can only trigger this effect on the same target once every 3s:
Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3 & 4, Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3 & 4, Resonance Skill Sync Strike: Armament Merge, Resonance Skill Sync Strike: Call of Dawn, Intro Skill Songs Across the Universe, and Intro Skill Debut of Meteoric Radiance.

Resonance Skill Seraphic Duet gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's Resonance Mode:
- In Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture, casting Resonance Skill Seraphic Duet additionally deals 5 instances of Tune Rupture DMG, with each instance dealt to a random target within range. The target's Off-Tune Level does not affect these instances of Tune Rupture DMG. When Seraphic Duet deals damage, remove the target's Rupturous Trail and increase the DMG Multiplier of Tune Rupture based on the number of stacks removed, each stack increasing the DMG Multiplier by 4% for 2.5s.
- In Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, when Resonance Skill Seraphic Duet hits the target, if they are inflicted with Fusion Trail, remove the Fusion Trail stacks, and trigger the Fusion Burst on the target based on its max stack limit without removing its stacks. Each stack of Fusion Trail removed increases the DMG Multiplier of Fusion Burst on the main target by 10%.

When in Stardust Resonance, Resonance Skill Seraphic Duet gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's Resonance Mode:
- In Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture, casting Resonance Skill Seraphic Duet additionally deal 10 instances of Tune Rupture DMG.
- In Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, the DMG Multiplier of Fusion Burst triggered by Resonance Skill Seraphic Duet on the main target is additionally increased by 200%. The DMG Multiplier increase effect is stackable with that provided by Fusion Trail.

Tune Rupture Response - Starburst
Active in Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture. Deal Fusion DMG to targets within range that are affected byTune Rupture - Interfered, considered Tune Rupture DMG.

Starflux Thrust
When in the Mech form and Starflux is more than 200, use the Utility button to cast Starflux Thrust and soar in the air by continuously consuming Starflux.

Synchronization Rate
Synchronization Rate is capped at 200 points.
- Dealing damage with Basic Attack - Aemeath, Mid-air Attack - Aemeath, Dodge Counter - Aemeath, Basic Attack - Mech, Mid-air Attack - Mech, Dodge Counter - Mech, Resonance Skill Sync Strike: Armament Merge, and Resonance Skill Sync Strike: Call of Dawn recovers Synchronization Rate.

- When in Instant Response and Heavenfall Edict: Unbound at the same time, casting Heavy Attack - Aemeath Charged II or Heavy Attack - Mech Charged II recovers 200 points of Synchronization Rate.

Resonance Rate
Resonance Rate is capped at 4 points.
- Casting Resonance Skill Seraphic Duet recovers 1 points of Resonance Rate.
- Casting Resonance Liberation Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive recovers 1 points of Resonance Rate.
- When in Starlume Acceleration, casting Resonance Liberation Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive additionally recovers 1 points of Resonance Rate.

Starflux
Starflux is capped at 600 points.
Starflux recovers naturally over time.
When in combat, Starflux recovers at a slower rate.

In Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture or Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, when Aemeath defeats a target affected by Rupturous Trail/Fusion Trail, she enters Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture/Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst for 10s.

basicAttacks.description:
Basic Attack - Present Self
Press Normal Attack consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG.
Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3 applies 1 stack of Glacio Chafe on hit.

Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self
When Dedication reaches 300 points, Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self becomes available.
Hold Normal Attack to shoot out 3 arrows one by one at the cost of STA, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Hiyuki is immune to interruptions in the duration.
When the last arrow is shot, 300 points of Dedication is consumed and Foreclaiming: Inward Vision becomes available. The arrow applies 1 stack of Glacio Chafe on hit.

Mid-air Attack - Present Self
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from Mid-air, dealing Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter - Present Self
Press Normal Attack within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.
Press Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3.

Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self
While in Foreclaimed Self, Basic Attack - Present Self is replaced by Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self.
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3, 4, and 5 each applies 1 stack of Glacio Chafe on hit.

Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self
In Foreclaimed Self, hold Normal Attack to enter Hold Breath, continuously consuming STA. When Normal Attack is released or STA is depleted, Hiyuki leaves the Hold Breath state and thrusts forward, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Press Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2.
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during the thrust, neutralize that instance of damage, Stagnate nearby targets, and become immune to interruptions for a certain period afterward while reducing all incoming damage by 100%. Press Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to chain into Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 4 instead.

Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self
When Whiteout Bitterfrost is full, Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self is replaced with Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self.
Hold Normal Attack and consume STA and 3 stacks of Whiteout Bitterfrost to gain 1 point of Snowforged Blade, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self applies 1 stack of Glacio Chafe on hit.
If Hiyuki is airborne while casting this skill, she'll land on the ground first.

Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self
While in Foreclaimed Self, Mid-air Attack - Present Self is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self.
Consume STA to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in Mid-air, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Stage 3 is a Plunging Attack.
Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2 & 3 apply 1 stack of Glacio Chafe on hit.
The Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self combo will not be reset by casting skills other than Basic Attack - Iai within a short period.
Hold Normal Attack while airborne to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.

liberationAttacks.name: Resonance Liberation: Foreclaiming
liberationAttacks.description:
Foreclaiming: Inward Vision
Heavy Attack - Foreclaiming: Inward Vision becomes available after casting Frost Splinter: Present Self.
While in Present Self, press Resonance Liberation to cast this skill, dealing Glacio DMG. Upon casting this skill, gain 3 points of Frostharden Iai, remove 300 points of Dedication and Frostheart. Then, enter Foreclaimed Self and restore 50 points of Frostheart.
Foreclaiming: Inward Vision applies 4 stacks of Glacio Chafe on hit.
Casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision does not consume Resonance Energy, and restores 50 points of Frostheart.

Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation
While in Foreclaimed Self, Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation can be cast via the following ways:
- Press Resonance Liberation and release to cast Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation. If Hiyuki has 3 points of Snowforged Blade, consume all Snowforged Blade. Otherwise, this cast does not consume Snowforged Blade.
- Hold Resonance Liberation to enter a charging state. During this state, consume 1 point of Snowforged Blade periodically. Release Resonance Liberation to cast Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation. If no Snowforged Blade is consumed when Resonance Liberation is released, Hiyuki will continue to charge the attack and cast the skill automatically after certain time. Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation will also be cast automatically when Snowforged Blade depletes.
Hiyuki deals Glacio DMG. Each point of Snowforged Blade consumed increases the DMG Multiplier of this attack.
Casting the skill consumes 300 points of Dedication and Frostheart, and ends Foreclaimed Self.

forteCircuitAttacks.name: Forte Circuit: Everfrost Dominion
forteCircuitAttacks.description:
Glacio Bite
- While Hiyuki is in the team, Glacio Chafe inflicted by nearby Resonators in the team is converted to Glacio Bite. Every time a new stack of Glacio Bite is inflicted on a target, an instance of Glacio Bite DMG is triggered based on that enemy's current Glacio Bite stack limit. Glacio Bite can be inflicted on frozen targets. Glacio Bite is also considered Glacio Chafe and Glacio Bite DMG is also considered Glacio Chafe DMG.
- When Foreclaiming: Inward Vision or Basic Attack - Iai hits a target, if the target has no fewer than 10 stacks of Glacio Chafe, consume 10 stacks and trigger Frostbind once.
- When Hiyuki joins the team, remove all stacks Glacio Chafe from the targets. When Hiyuki leaves the team, if there is no other Resonator in the team who can convert Glacio Chafe into Glacio Chafe, all enemies' Glacio Bite stacks are cleared.

Present Self
Hiyuki starts in Present Self. While in Present Self, casting certain skills restores Dedication.

Foreclaimed Self
Hiyuki enters Foreclaimed Self after casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision. While in Foreclaimed Self, Hiyuki unlocks a new form and restores Frostheart by casting certain skills.

Iai Stance
If Hiyuki has at least 100 points of Frostheart, performing any of the following actions causes her to flash backward at the cost of STA and enter Iai Stance:
- Press Dodge after casting any Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self other than Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self, Frostblight: Jade Cleave, Frostblight: Petalfall, Basic Attack - Iai, or Intro Skill - Frostedge.
- Hold Resonance Skill within a certain period after casting Frostblight: Jade Cleave or Frostblight: Petalfall.
While performing the actions above, if there is a valid target within the range and the forward input is held down, Hiyuki instead flashes behind the enemy at the cost of STA and enters Iai Stance.
Hiyuki may enter Iai Stance while airborne. Upon entering the Iai Stance, Hiyuki's mid-air Dodge charges are reset. Iai Stance ends if Hiyuki is switched out.

Basic Attack - Iai
Within a certain period upon after entering Iai Stance, press Normal Attack and consume 100 points of Frostheart to cast Basic Attack - Iai, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
If Frostheart remains at 100 points or above after casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a certian period to cast Basic Attack - Iai again.
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during Basic Attack - Iai, neutralize this instance of damage and become immune to interruptions for a certain duration afterwards while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%.
Each time Basic Attack - Iai is cast, if Hiyuki has Frostharden Iai, consume 1 stack of Frostharden Iai to inflict 3 stacks of Glacio Chafe on hit, and gain 1 stack of Whiteout Bitterfrost.

Dedication
Hiyuki holds up to 300 points of Dedication.
While in Present Self, casting Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3 restores 100 points of Dedication and casting Resonance Skill - Present Self enhances the next Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3, which now additionally restores 100 points of Dedication. This effect ends when Hiyuki is switched out.

Frostheart
Hiyuki holds up to 300 points of Frostheart.
Frostheart is restored while casting Frostblight: Jade Cleave and Frostblight: Petalfall, or when Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self other than Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self hits the target.

Frostharden Iai
Frostharden Iai has a maximum of 3 points.
Casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision grants 3 points of Frostharden Iai.

Whiteout Bitterfrost
Whiteout Bitterfrost stacks up to 3 times.
Each time Frostharden Iai is consumed through Basic Attack - Iai, gain 1 stack of Whiteout Bitterfrost.

Snowforged Blade
Snowforged Blade stacks up to 3 times.
Each time Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self is cast, gain 1 stack of Snowforged Blade.

basicAttacks.name: Normal Attack: Reign of Silence
basicAttacks.description:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack Stage 2 to cast Rending Lunge.

Rending Lunge
Deal Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast Death Snip.
Use Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill in mid-air to cast Hanging Finality.

Death Snip
Open the scissors, dealing Havoc DMG. After a while, the scissors snip, dealing Havoc DMG and restoring HP for all nearby Resonators in the team.
Use Normal Attack during this skill to deal additional Havoc DMG. Use Normal Attack again to immediately snip the target.
The skill DMG is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Death Snip to cast Thread Withdrawn.

Thread Withdrawn
Deal Havoc DMG.
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after being cast.

Heavy Attack
Leap into the air and consume STA to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
This skill cannot be cast while in Chainsaw Mode.
Perform the following actions within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Hanging Finality:
- Press Normal Attack;
- Cast Lifethread - Glide and press Normal Attack before landing.
Hold Normal Attack before landing after casting Heavy Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Severed Facet.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.
While not in Chainsaw Mode, press Normal Attack within a certain time after casting Mid-air Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Severed Facet
Deal Havoc DMG.
Use Normal Attack within a certain time after casting Heavy Attack - Severed Facet to cast Hanging Finality.
If interrupted, Heavy Attack - Severed Facet can be cast again by holding Normal Attack before landing. This effect can be triggered once only before landing.

Hanging Finality
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast Death Snip.

Dodge Counter
Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Rending Lunge.

Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction
Hold Dodge after a successful Dodge on the ground to cast Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction to attack and Stagnate the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
- While not in Chainsaw Mode, after casting this skill, Press Normal Attack on the ground or use Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Rending Lunge. This effect is removed when Chisa enters Chainsaw Mode.
- While in Chainsaw Mode, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3.

skillAttacks.name: Resonance Skill: Fractured Composition
skillAttacks.description:
Eye of Unraveling
Stagnate and deal Havoc DMG.
- While not in Chainsaw Mode, after casting this skill, press Normal Attack on the ground or use Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Rending Lunge. This effect is removed when Chisa enters Chainsaw Mode.
- While in Chainsaw Mode and on the ground, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Serrated Loop
While on the ground and Ring of Chainsaw is full, Resonance Skill is replaced with Serrated Loop.
Stagnate targets, and deal Havoc DMG and pull in nearby targets.
Casting this skill sends Chisa into Chainsaw Mode and replaces Resonance Skill with Eye of Unraveling.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2.
Hold Resonance Skill while casting this skill to continuously attack and pull in nearby targets. Release the Resonance Skill button in the duration or keep holding it for a certain period of time to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 1.

liberationAttacks.name: Resonance Liberation: Moment of Nihility
liberationAttacks.description:
Deal Havoc DMG and recover HP for all nearby Resonators in the team.
Casting this skill sends Chisa into Woven Myriad - Convergence for 15s.
While not in Chainsaw Mode, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Woven Myriad - Convergence
The DMG Multipliers of Sawring - Blitz, Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter, and Sawring - Eradication are increased by 120%.
The bonus DMG Multiplier for Sawring - Eradication granted by Sawring- Blitz and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter when Ring of Chainsaw is consumed additionally increases by 120%.
Casting Sawring - Eradication ends Woven Myriad - Convergence.

forteCircuitAttacks.name: Forte Circuit: Sight of Unraveling - Oblivion
forteCircuitAttacks.description:
Unseen Snare
Chisa inflicts Unseen Snare on the target for 30s in the following 4 ways:
- Hitting a target with Resonance Skill.
- Hitting a target within a certain period of time after casting Serrated Loop.
- Hitting a target with Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction.
- Locking on to a target.
When targets marked by Unseen Snare take direct damage from Resonators, Chisa inflicts 1 stack of Havoc Bane on them. This effect can be triggered up to once every 2s.

Thread of Bane
When dealing damage to targets affected by Unseen Snare, ignore 18% of their DEF.

Chainsaw Mode
While in Chainsaw Mode, Chisa unlocks Sawring - Blitz, Sawring - Eradication, Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter.
Sawring - Blitz and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter consume Ring of Chainsaw on hit.

Sawring - Blitz
Sawring - Blitz chains up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack to start the combo from Sawring - Blitz Stage 1. Hold Normal Attack to start from Sawring - Blitz Stage 2.
Hold Normal Attack while casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 2 to continuously attack the target. Sawring - Blitz Stage 2 is automatically followed by Sawring - Blitz Stage 3.
While casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 2, release the Normal Attack button or Dodge without directional input to automatically cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance, dealing Havoc DMG. Shortly after casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance, successful Dodges can be triggered.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3.
While casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 3, hold Normal Attack to continuously attack the target. Sawring - Blitz Stage 3 is automatically followed by Sawring - Eradication.
Release Normal Attack during Sawring - Blitz Stage 3 to automatically cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone, dealing Havoc DMG.
Sawring - Blitz DMG is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.

Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter
While in Chainsaw Mode, press Normal Attack following a successful Dodge to cast Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter, dealing Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack following Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3.
Hold Normal Attack while casting Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter to sustain the attack. When Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter ends, cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3 automatically.
Release the Normal Attack button or Dodge without directional input while casting Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance automatically.
Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter deals Resonance Liberation DMG.

Sawring - Eradication
While in Chainsaw Mode, Chisa casts Sawring - Eradication in the following 2 ways:
- Press Normal Attack after casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone.
- Press Normal Attack after consuming all Ring of Chainsaw with Sawring - Blitz or Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter.
Attacking targets with Sawring - Eradication deals Havoc DMG and grants Shields to all nearby Resonators in the team for 30s.
The skill DMG is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Every 1 point of Ring of Chainsaw consumed by Sawring - Blitz and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter increases the DMG Multiplier of the next Sawring - Eradication. Up to 100 points will be counted toward this effect.
Casting this skill consumes all Ring of Chainsaw and ends Chainsaw Mode.

Chainsaw Fever
While in Chainsaw Mode, Lifethread - Jetstream is replaced with Chainsaw Fever.
Chainsaw Fever is at 100% by default.
When Chisa goes on for a period without dealing any damage, Chainsaw Fever will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa enters the Burnout State and exits Chainsaw Mode.
While in Chainsaw Mode, Chisa resets Chainsaw Fever when dealing damage or when casting Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility, Intro Skill Reverberance - Return and Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone.
While in the Burnout State, Ring of Chainsaw will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa exits the Burnout State.
When in Burnout State, Chisa exits the state upon dealing damage, or casting Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility and Intro Skill Reverberance - Return.

Lifethread - Glide
When Chisa is not in Chainsaw Mode and has more than 10 points of Lifethread - Jetstream, she can consume 50 points of Lifethread - Jetstream to cast Lifethread - Glide in the following 5 ways:
- Press Dodge in mid-air before landing after casting Heavy Attack.
- While in mid-air, press Dodge before landing after casting Resonance Skill Eye of Unraveling or Rending Lunge.
- Dodge forward shortly after casting Thread Withdrawn.
- Press Dodge before landing when launched into mid-air.
- Press Dodge before landing after casting Lifethread - Glide.
Casting this skill can pull in nearby enemies marked by Unseen Snare.
During the skill, hold Dodge to glide a short distance on the weapon.
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after casting this skill.

Ring of Chainsaw
Chisa can hold up to 100 points of Ring of Chainsaw.
Hitting a target with Normal Attack and Resonance Skill Eye of Unraveling grants Ring of Chainsaw.
Casting Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility grants 40 points of Ring of Chainsaw.
Casting Intro Skill Reverberance - Return grants 20 points of Ring of Chainsaw.

Lifethread - Jetstream
Chisa can hold up to 100 points of Lifethread - Jetstream.
Chisa continuously obtains Lifethread - Jetstream over time.
Chisa obtains 100 points of Lifethread - Jetstream upon defeating a target.
Exiting Chainsaw Mode resets Lifethread - Jetstream to the max limit.
Chisa cannot obtain Lifethread - Jetstream passively for a short period of time after casting Lifethread - Glide.

Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang

While in the Yang Font state, Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang is available, which deals Fusion DMG.
Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang can be cast in mid-air.

Cleanse of Impurity

Casting Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin or Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang grants Cleanse of Impurity for 4s or until one of the following conditions is met:
- Switching to another Resonator.
- Switching to the Yin Vessel or Yang Font state.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse or Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide.

Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse

While in the Yin Vessel state with Cleanse of Impurity, press or hold Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Casting Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, restores 100 points of Qi.

liberationAttacks.description:

Yinghuo

forteCircuitAttacks.name: Forte Circuit: Upstream Along Santu
forteCircuitAttacks.description:
Qi Modulation

Jingran switches between the Yin Vessel and Yang Font states by casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander. Jingran is in the Yang Font state by default.

Heavy Attack - Soul Raid

When Jingran holds 300 points of Qi while in the Yin Vessel state, hold Normal Attack to consume 300 points of Qi to cast Heavy Attack - Soul Raid, dealing Fusion DMG.
After casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid, Jingran switches to the Yang Font state.
Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander

When Jingran holds 300 points of Qi while in the Yang Font state, hold Normal Attack to consume 300 points of Qi to cast Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, dealing Fusion DMG.
After casting Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, Jingran switches to the Yin Vessel state.
Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander can be cast in mid-air.

Qi

Max 300 points.
- Casting Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 3, Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 4, Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 3, or Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 4 restores 50 points of Qi.
- Casting Dodge Counter - Nether Dive, Dodge Counter - Light Watch, Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide, or Intro Skill - Question the Tombs restores 100 points of Qi.
- Casting Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls or casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander with Wayfarer's Mark restores 200 points of Qi.

Fire of Life

Max 100 points.
- Casting Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls grants 100 points of Fire of Life.
- All Fire of Life is cleared when Yinghuo ends.
While in Yinghuo, if Fire of Life is not at 0 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=A}, casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander consumes 25 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=B} of Fire of Life, and the DMG Multiplier of this Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander is increased based on Jingran's Max HP: The DMG Multiplier of this Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander is increased for every 1000 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=C} of Jingran's Max HP over 25000. Up to 25000 points of Jingran's Max HP count towards this effect.

Nether to Light

- Jingran gains Fusion DMG Bonus based on Max HP: For every 1000 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=E} of Max HP, Jingran receives 1.5% Fusion DMG Bonus, up to 75%.

Yang Changes, Yin Unites

Jingran gains additional ATK based on Max HP: For every 1000 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=F} of Max HP, Jingran gains 36 additional ATK, up to 1800.

While in the Yin Vessel state, press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
While in the Yang Font state, press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

Max 50 stacks. Each stack of Fortune in Disguise grants additional Fusion DMG Bonus based on Jingran's Max HP: For every 1000 points of Max HP, Jingran gains 0.05% additional Fusion DMG Bonus for 15s, up to 2.5% for each stack of Fortune in Disguise.

Can be cast in mid-air.

- While turned into the Moon Fox and out of combat, Hsin gains Dustless Tread. With Dustless Tread, Hsin can enter the target's aggro range without triggering combat. Dustless Tread is removed when Hsin enters combat, is switched out, or ends the Moon Fox form by having environmental, gameplay, or feature interactions.
- While turned into the Moon Fox and out of combat, Hsin restores 6% of Max HP every 3s.
- Taking damage, failing to perform a Dodge with directional input while on the ground, or Dodging in mid-air will end the Moon Fox form. Switching to another Resonator or pressing Resonance Skill also ends the Moon Fox form. Press Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4, which also ends the Moon Fox form.
- The Dash state continuously consumes STA when Hsin is in the Moon Fox form.
- Resonance Liberation is disabled when Hsin is in the Moon Fox form.

Resonance Skill - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form and Hsin is on the ground, press Resonance Skill to have Hsin command a Colossal Xuanfang Mechanism, dealing Electro DMG.

liberationAttacks.name: Resonance Liberation: Nexus Alight
liberationAttacks.description:
Formshift

Casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer unlocks Formshift.
Cast Formshift to unfurl the Manifold Sanctum. Hsin turns into Illumining Form, unlocking a new set of combat abilities, and enters the Heart Manifest state.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
While in Illumining Form, engaging in quest dialogue, performing an environmental interaction with an animation, or using a Utility switches Hsin back to Answering Form to perform the corresponding action.
While in Illumining Form, Hsin can walk on the surface of water, and will continuously consume STA in the deep water areas. In Walking Mode, Hsin in Illumining Form can step off a cliff into the air and walk slowly in mid-air, continuously consuming STA in this state. Hsin cannot restore STA while in Illumining Form and in mid-air.

Pillars Across Heaven

Casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons unlocks Pillars Across Heaven.
Cast Pillars Across Heaven to bring the Manifold Sanctum crashing down, dealing Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Hsin returns to Answering Form and exits the Heart Manifest state.

Edict

Casting Formshift grants Hsin 21 stacks of Edict for 45s. The effect cannot exceed 21 stacks and all stacks are removed when the duration ends.
After the active Resonator in the team deals DMG, Hsin automatically consumes Edict in the following 3s to trigger the following effect up to once per second. Retriggering the effect resets the duration:
- When Edict is consumed, summon a Soaring Pillar from the Manifold Sanctum as a Coordinated Attack to strike the target once, dealing Electro DMG.
- Edict can be automatically consumed up to 1 stack per second.
- Damage dealt by Soaring Pillar does not trigger this effect.
- When Hsin is knocked out, all Edict stacks are removed.

Heart Manifest

Increases Hsin's resistance to interruption for 45s.
Entering the Heart Manifest state resets Hsin's Illumining Form.
While in the Heart Manifest state and in Illumining Form, if Pillars Across Heaven has not been unlocked, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Answering. While in Answering Form, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Illumining.

Invoked Form: Answering

Hsin temporarily reverts to Answering Form. When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2; if She is in mid-air, She casts Mid-air Attack - Answering Form.

Invoked Form: Illumining

Hsin turns back into Illumining Form. When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts Upward Cut - Illumining Form; if She is in mid-air, She casts Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form.

forteCircuitAttacks.name: Forte Circuit: Forms Turn, Heart Abides
forteCircuitAttacks.description:
Forms Born of Heart

While in Answering Form, Hsin can gain and consume Answering Heart.
While in Illumining Form, Hsin can gain and consume Illumining Heart.

Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer

While in Answering Form, when Hsin's Answering Heart reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack - Answering Form is replaced with Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer.
Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill at the cost of STA and 100 points of Answering Heart. Hsin is immune to interruption during the action, and deals Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer grants Hsin Resolution of Wishes. This Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer consumes Resolution of Wishes to become Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector, dealing greater DMG. Resolution of Wishes can only be gained once every 24s.
While casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer or Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector, if Hsin is not in the Heart Manifest state, unlock Resonance Liberation - Formshift.

Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons

While in Illumining Form, when Hsin consumes all of her Illumining Heart during the Mechanism Dominion state, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form is replaced with Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons.
Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons grants Hsin Law of Heaven. This Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons consumes Law of Heaven to become Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons, dealing greater DMG. Law of Heaven can only be gained once every 24s.
Casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons or Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons ends the Mechanism Dominion state and unlocks Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven.

Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned

While in Illumining Form, when Hsin's Illumining Heart reaches 300 points and She is on the ground, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned.
When Hsin is on the ground, press Resonance Skill to deal Electro DMG to surrounding targets, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Casting Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned sends Hsin into the Mechanism Dominion state.

Mechanism Dominion

The Mechanism Dominion state lasts 13s.
While this state is active, Basic Attack - Illumining Form is replaced with Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned, and Dodge Counter - Illumining Form is replaced with Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned.
When Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned or Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned hits a target, Illumining Heart is consumed if Hsin is the active Resonator.
Exiting Mechanism Dominion clears Illumining Heart.

Resonance Mode - Unison

While in Resonance Mode - Unison, Hsin gains the following effects:
- Hsin can trigger Unison Response, but not in Co-op Mode.
- After casting Intro Skill - Answering Form or Intro Skill - Illumining Form, the next Resonance Liberation - Formshift grants Hsin Unison for 5s.
- When Hsin triggers Unison Response, She gains Source Intent, and the Intro Skill cast this time is replaced with Intro Skill - Manifold Unison, dealing greater DMG.
When Hsin casts an Intro Skill without triggering Unison Response while holding Source Intent, She consumes Source Intent instead, and the Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill - Manifold Unison, dealing greater DMG.
- The effects on Hsin mentioned above are removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
- Casting Intro Skill - Illumining Form or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison sends Hsin directly into the Mechanism Dominion state.

Resonance Mode - Electro Flare

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, Hsin gains the following effects:
- When Hsin enters combat, targets within a certain range do not lose Electro Flare stacks when it's triggered automatically.
- After Resonators in the team inflict Electro Rage to a target, every 1 stacks of Electro Rage inflicted grants Hsin 1 stacks of Heart of Thunder, stacking up to 100 times, and consumes all Electro Rage stacks from that target. Heart of Thunder is removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
- At the last stage of Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, Hsin actively triggers 1 instance of Electro Flare DMG on the targets. Its DMG Multiplier equals to 35% x (the number of Heart of Thunder stacks on Hsin) x (the Electro Flare DMG Multiplier corresponding to the target's current Electro Flare stacks).
While casting Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, switching to another Resonator or ending the skill early will end the above effects early.
Some time after casting Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, Hsin consumes all remaining stacks of Heart of Thunder.
When Hsin has at least 50 stacks of Heart of Thunder, Resonance Skill - Illuming Form stagnates nearby targets during the action.
- After casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift, inflict 5 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=E} of Electro Flare on nearby targets within a certain range. It also makes Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned or Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned inflict Electro Flare on hit targets, up to 5 {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=A}. Casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift again resets this count. Switching Resonance Mode removes it.
Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned and Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons inflict 5 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=E} of Electro Flare on the target hit. Intro Skill - Illumining Form, Intro Skill - Answering Form, and Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector inflict 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=F} of Electro Flare on the target hit.

Unison

While Hsin is in Resonance Mode - Unison with Unison, switching to another Resonator will remove Hsin's Unison to trigger Hsin's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. If Hsin has full Concerto Energy and Unison at the same time, only Unison is consumed to trigger the effect.

Unison Response

While Hsin is in Resonance Mode - Unison and the active Resonator in the team has Unison, Hsin triggers Unison Response when she is switched in and casts Intro Skill, granting 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=G} of Unison Boon to all Resonators in the team for 30s.
Hsin can only grant up to 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=G} of Unison Boon in this way.

Unison Boon

Each stack of Unison Boon increases the total DMG dealt by Resonators with the Unison Response ability in the team by 3%, stacking up to 2 times.

Answering Heart

Can hold up to 100 points of Answering Heart.
While in Answering Form, when Normal Attack - Answering Form, Resonance Skill - Answering Form, Intro Skill - Answering Form, or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison hits a target, Hsin gains Answering Heart if She is the active Resonator.
Casting Intro Skill - Answering Form or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison grants 60 points of Answering Heart.

Illumining Heart

Can hold up to 300 points of Illumining Heart.
While in Illumining Form and not in the Mechanism Dominion state, when Normal Attack - Illumining Form, or Resonance Skill - Illumining Form hits a target, Hsin gains Illumining Heart if She is the active Resonator.
- While in Resonance Mode - Unison, casting Intro Skill - Illumining Form or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison directly sends Hsin into the Mechanism Dominion state and grants 300 points of Illumining Heart.
- While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, after casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift, when the Modular Heartlock generated by Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 1 is collapsed by Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 2, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form, Dodge Counter - Illumining Form, or Resonance Skill - Illumining Form, gain 150 points of Illumining Heart if Hsin is the active Resonator. This effect can only be triggered once before the next cast of Resonance Liberation - Formshift resets it, and is disabled when switched to the other Resonance Mode.

After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3 (when in Resonance Mode - Unison) or Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4 (when in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare).

Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison

The skill becomes available when in Answering Form. Attack the target, dealing greater Electro DMG, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3.

This skill becomes available while in Illumining Form. Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

outroAttacks.name: Outro Skill: Herself a Thousand Lanterns
outroAttacks.description:
Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG equal to 100% of Hsin's ATK.
Hsin gains Nightglow upon entering combat or casting Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven. When Hsin casts Outro Skill, Nightglow is consumed to trigger various effects depending on the Resonance Mode She is in:
- While in Resonance Mode - Unison, Resonators in the team other than Hsin gain Shared Light when they gain Unison. After Hsin casts Outro Skill, Resonators with Shared Light gain 20% All DMG Amplification for 30s.
- While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, Electro DMG dealt by Resonators in the team other than Hsin is Amplified by 20% for 20s.
The above effects end early when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.

tuneBreakAttacks.name: Tune Break: Tune Break: Rectifier
tuneBreakAttacks.description: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.

buffs.name: Inherent Skill: Tides of Succession
buffs.details: While in Resonance Mode - Unison, when Hsin casts Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison, She gains 50% ATK for 8s. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect.

buffs.name: Inherent Skill: Tides of Succession
buffs.details: While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, after Resonators in the team inflict Electro Flare, Hsin gains 25% Electro DMG Bonus, stacking up to 2 times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once.

buffs.name: Inherent Skill: Tides of Succession
buffs.details:
While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, after Resonators in the team inflict Electro Flare. In addition, if Rover: Electro is in the same team, when Rover: Electro casts Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury, both Hsin and Rover: Electro gain 20% Electro DMG Bonus for 30s.
This effect resets when a Resonator is added to the team or when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.

buffs.name: Inherent Skill: Gleaning Simple Joys
buffs.details: While in Resonance Mode - Unison, the maximum stacks of the Unison Boon effect on Resonators in the team are increased by 1. When a Resonator in the team triggers Unison Response, all Resonators in the team gain 1 stacks of Unison Boon for 30s. This effect can only grant up to 1 stacks of Unison Boon.

buffs.name: Inherent Skill: Gleaning Simple Joys
buffs.details:
While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare and Hsin is not in the Heart Manifest state, Hsin gains 1 stack of Thunderglow after Resonators in the team other than Hsin inflict Electro Flare, stacking up to 10 times.
While Hsin is in the Heart Manifest state, when targets within a certain range around the active Resonator have 0 stacks of Electro Flare, inflict 1 stack of Electro Flare on the targets. If Thunderglow on Hsin reaches the stack limit, Hsin also inflicts Fleeting Thunder on the targets:
- When Hsin inflicts Fleeting Thunder on the target, she also inflicts Electro Flare on the target to the stack limit, up to 16 stacks of Electro Flare.
- When Fleeting Thunder is active, if the maximum stacks of Electro Flare on the target are increased, Hsin will inflict Electro Flare on the target to the stack limit again, up to 16 stacks of Electro Flare.
- When Fleeting Thunder is active, the Electro Flare stacks on the target will not be reduced when automatically triggered.
- Fleeting Thunder will be removed when the target leaves the designated range around Hsin.
Exiting the Heart Manifest state or switching Resonance Mode removes the effects mentioned above.

buffs.name: Resonance Mode - Electro Flare: Heart of Thunder (Delayed)
buffs.details: Some time after casting Resonance Skill - Illumining Form while in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, Hsin consumes all remaining stacks of Heart of Thunder at once to trigger 1 instance of Electro Flare DMG, with its DMG Multiplier equal to 35% times the number of Heart of Thunder stacks consumed this time, times the Electro Flare DMG Multiplier corresponding to the target's current Electro Flare stacks.

buffs.name: Unison Boon
buffs.details: Each stack of Unison Boon increases the total DMG Hsin deals by 3%, stacking up to 2 times.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 1: A Boat to Cross the Rising Tide
resonanceChains.details:
Casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift grants Hsin 2 stacks of Radiance Ward, stacking up to 2 times. Switching to Answering Form clears all stacks. When Hsin takes DMG from an enemy target's attack, 1 stack of Radiance Ward can be consumed to make Her immune to interruption and reduce DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once every 1s.

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare:
When Hsin enters combat, if Heart of Thunder is below 50 stacks, it is increased to 50 stacks, triggered once every 12s.
The DMG Multiplier of the Electro Flare DMG triggered by Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon is increased to 42% x (the number of Heart of Thunder stacks on Hsin) x (the Electro Flare DMG Multiplier corresponding to the target's current Electro Flare stacks).

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 1: A Boat to Cross the Rising Tide (Unison)
resonanceChains.details:
While in Resonance Mode - Unison:
The DMG Multipliers of Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison and Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison are increased by 15%, and each stack of Unison Boon additionally increases the DMG Multipliers of Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison and Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison by 10%, up to a total of 4 stacks.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 2: To Wake Is to Wonder What I Am
resonanceChains.details:
The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer and Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector are increased by 60%.
The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons and Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons are increased by 60%.

When Hsin enters combat, reset the Cooldowns for Hsin to gain Resolution of Wishes and Law of Heaven, and restore 100 additional points of Answering Heart. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 3: A Dream of Return Among the Hills
resonanceChains.details: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven is increased by 70%.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 3: A Dream of Return Among the Hills (Unison)
resonanceChains.details:
While in Resonance Mode - Unison:
The Crit. DMG of Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven is increased by 20%, and each stack of Unison Boon additionally increases its Crit. DMG by 15%, up to a total of 4 stacks.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 3: A Dream of Return Among the Hills (Electro Flare)
resonanceChains.details:
While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare:
When the last stage of Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven hits a target inflicted with Electro Flare, it triggers 1 instance of Electro Flare DMG, with its DMG Multiplier equal to 1500% times the Electro Flare DMG Multiplier corresponding to the current Electro Flare stacks on the target.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 4: A River of Lanterns, a River of Wishes
resonanceChains.details:
All Resonators in the team gain 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 30s when a Resonator in the team triggers any of the following actions:
- Inflict Electro Flare or Electro Rage on a target.
- Gain Unison while not having the effect.
- Trigger Unison Response.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 5: Forms Turn as the Heart Wills
resonanceChains.details:
While in Illumining Form, DMG taken by Hsin is reduced by 20%.
When Hsin takes a fatal blow, She will not be knocked out, but instead restores 100% of Max HP and becomes immune to DMG and interruption for 1s. This effect can be triggered once every 10 minute.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 6: The Moon Owes Its Light to the Living
resonanceChains.details:
Targets take 40% more Resonance Skill DMG from Hsin.

Resonance Skill DMG dealt by Hsin ignores 20% of the target's DEF.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 6: The Moon Owes Its Light to the Living (Unison)
resonanceChains.details:
While in Resonance Mode - Unison:
The maximum stacks of the Unison Boon effect on Resonators in the team are additionally increased by 1. When a Resonator in the team triggers Unison Response, all Resonators in the team additionally gain 1 stack of Unison Boon for 30s. This effect does not stack.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 6: The Moon Owes Its Light to the Living (Electro Flare)
resonanceChains.details:
While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare:
While in combat, Electro Flare DMG taken by targets within a certain range around Hsin can be Critical, with Crit. Rate fixed at 80% and Crit. DMG fixed at 230%.

weaponPassives.details: Increases ATK by 12%/15%/18%/21%/24%.
After applying Tune Strain - Shifting, gain 11.2%/14%/16.8%/19.6%/22.4% Aero DMG Bonus, lasting 2/2/2/2/2s, stacking up to 5/5/5/5/5 times. This effect can trigger once every 0.5/0.5/0.5/0.5/0.5s.

Upon reaching the max stack limit, gain the following effects:
- This Aero DMG Bonus effect's duration is extended to 15/15/15/15/15s.
- While the effect persists, Aero DMG ignores 10%/12.5%/15%/17.5%/20% of the target's DEF.

basicAttacks.name: Normal Attack: Strings to Steel
basicAttacks.description:
Basic Attack - Stringblade

Press repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 1 and Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4 are in Sheathed Stance.
Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 2 and Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3 are in Drawn Stance.

Heavy Attack - Stringblade

When Qin Heart and Sword Cadence are full, Heavy Attack - Stringblade becomes available.
Hold Normal Attack to consume STA and cast this skill, dealing Aero DMG.
Casting this skill consumes all Qin Heart and Sword Cadence and sends Qingxiao into the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Mid-air Attack - Stringblade

Press Normal Attack consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
This skill is in Drawn Stance.
After landing from Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3, press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.
While in mid-air, Resonance Skill is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.

Plunging Attack

While in the Sword Flight state, Jump is replaced by Plunging Attack.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG.
While out of the Ephemeral Transcendence state, press Normal Attack within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.

Dodge Counter - Stringblade

Press Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
This skill is in Drawn Stance.
Press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4.

Sword Glide

While in mid-air, Dodge is replaced by Sword Glide.

skillAttacks.name: Resonance Skill: Severing Note
skillAttacks.description:
Severing Note: Judgement

Deal Aero DMG. During this skill, gain 45 points of Qin Heart.
While not in the Ephemeral Transcendence state, press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4.

Severing Note: Ascendant

While casting Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 2, Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3, or Dodge Counter - Stringblade, Resonance Skill is replaced by Severing Note: Ascendant.
Deal Aero DMG.
This skill is in Drawn Stance.

liberationAttacks.name: Resonance Liberation: Billows Beneath Heaven
liberationAttacks.description:
Deal Aero DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

forteCircuitAttacks.name: Forte Circuit: Formless Heart Sword
forteCircuitAttacks.description:
Ephemeral Transcendence

While Qingxiao is in the Ephemeral Transcendence state, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence and Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence become available.

Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence

Press repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
Before Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by 100%.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence

Press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
Before Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by 100%.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence

When Heart Sword Intent is full, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available. Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill, dealing Aero DMG.
Casting this skill consumes all Heart Sword Intent and ends the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Mindlock

Mindlock stacks up to 15 times.
Each time when a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Interfered on a target, inflict 1 stacks of Mindlock on the target.
For each stack of Mindlock on the target, DMG taken from Qingxiao's following skills is Amplified by 2%, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.
- Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven.

Heaven's Clarity

Upon entering combat or casting Resonance Liberation Billows Beneath Heaven, gain Heaven's Clarity.
When Sheathed Stance/Drawn Stance moves deal damage, the rates at which Qin Heart/Sword Cadence are obtained increase by 100%.
When casting Heavy Attack - Stringblade, inflict 3 stacks of Mindlock on nearby targets, and enhance the next Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence: its DMG Multiplier is increased by 100% and it builds additional Off-Tune Level on the target. Switching to another Resonator ends the Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence enhancement.
Casting Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence removes Heaven's Clarity.

Swordlight Ward

Casting Intro Skill - Tonality Shift or Heavy Attack - Stringblade grants 1 stacks of Swordlight Ward.
Swordlight Ward stacks up to 1 times. When taking DMG from an enemy's attack, 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=A} of Swordlight Ward can be consumed to grant immunity to interruption and reduce DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once per second.

Sword Flight

While in the Sword Flight state, Qingxiao moves with a special animation.
Moving in Sword Flight continuously consumes Flight Qi.
- Casting the following skills sends Qingxiao into the Sword Flight state:
Sword Dodge, Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 1, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 2, Severing Note: Ascendant, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, and Intro Skill - Tonality Shift.

tuneBreakAttacks.name: Tune Break: Draw and Sunder
tuneBreakAttacks.description:
Qingxiao inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the target after dealing damage with skills. Each skill can only trigger this once for the same target.
Qingxiao can respond to Tune Strain - Interfered.
Responding to Tune Strain - Interfered: For each stack of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target, every point of Qingxiao's Tune Break Boost increases the total DMG Qingxiao deals to that target by 0.12%. While Qingxiao is in the team, the max stack limit of Tune Strain - Interfered on a target is increased by 1.
Additionally, when the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Qingxiao can cast Tune Break on it. While on the ground and not in the Ephemeral Transcendence state, press Normal Attack within a certain time after casting Tune Break to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.

buffs.name: Basic Attack: Ephemeral Transcendence
buffs.details: Press repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to unleash up to 4 consecutive strikes, dealing Aero DMG. Before Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence is unlocked, this skill gains a 100% DMG Multiplier increase.

buffs.name: Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence
buffs.details: Pressing Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge will strike the target, dealing Aero DMG. Before Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence is unlocked, this skill gains a 100% DMG Multiplier increase. Can be cast while in mid-air.

buffs.name: Mindlock
buffs.details: Mindlock has a maximum of 15 stacks. When Resonators in the team inflict Tune Strain - Interfered, apply 1 stack of Mindlock to the target. For each stack of Mindlock on the target, DMG taken by the target from the following Qingxiao skills is Amplified by 2%. This effect increases by 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks. - Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Skill - Billows Beneath Heaven.

buffs.name: Heavens Clarity
buffs.details: Upon entering combat or casting Resonance Skill - Billows Beneath Heaven, gain Heavens Clarity. - When casting Heavy Attack - Stringblade, apply 2 stacks of Mindlock to nearby targets. The DMG Multiplier of the next Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence is increased by 100%. Switching to another Resonator ends DMG Multiplier increase effect. Casting Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence removes Heavens Clarity.

buffs.name: Inherent Skill: Sea of Thought, World of Dust
buffs.details:
Upon entering combat, gain 1 stacks of Gathered Mind.

After damage dealt directly by Resonators in the team defeats a target inflicted with the Mindlock effect:
If Qingxiao does not have the Gathered Mind effect, gain Gathered Mind with stacks equal to the target's Mindlock stacks.
If Qingxiao already has Gathered Mind and the target's Mindlock stacks are no fewer than Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks, update Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks to match the target's Mindlock stacks.

Gathered Mind

After Resonators in the team deal damage to a target, inflict Mindlock equal to Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks. This effect can only trigger 1 times on the same target.
When Resonators in the team cast Tune Break, if the target has Tune Strain - Shifting, additionally inflict 1 stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target. This effect can only trigger 1 times on the same target.
When Qingxiao is knocked out, she can no longer gain Gathered Mind, and any existing Gathered Mind effect becomes inactive.
Gathered Mind stacks up to 15 times and lasts for 30s.

buffs.name: Inherent Skill: To Know, To Banish
buffs.details:
Qingxiao's following skills deal 2% more DMG per stack of Mindlock on the target, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.
- Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven.

Each time after a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Interfered on an Overlord Class or Calamity Class target, additionally inflict 1 stacks of Mindlock on the target.

resonanceChains.details:

Upon entering combat, gain 25 stack of Exorcising Seal.
After Basic Attack - Stringblade, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade, or Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence deals damage, if Qingxiao has Exorcising Seal, remove Exorcising Seal and trigger Juque Perdition, dealing Aero DMG equal to 400% of Qingxiao's ATK, considered Basic Attack DMG. This effect can be triggered up to once per second.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 1: Like Clouds That Meet and Drift Apart: Exorcising Seal
resonanceChains.details:
For each stack of Exorcising Seal removed, the target takes 4% more DMG from Juque Perdition for 1s.
Exorcising Seal stacks up to 25 times.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 2: Like Petals That Fall Without a Sound
resonanceChains.details:
The DMG Multiplier of Heavy Attack - Stringblade is increased by 40%.

When in combat, the max stack limit of Mindlock on nearby enemies is increased to 25.
The max stack limit of Gathered Mind from Inherent Skill - Sea of Thought, World of Dust is increased to 25.

Heaven's Clarity is enhanced:
Casting Heavy Attack - Stringblade now inflicts 6 stack of Mindlock on nearby targets.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 3: Dreams Fade, Sword Abides
resonanceChains.details:
The Crit. DMG of Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven is increased by 100%.

During Heavy Attack - Stringblade, gain World in Chorus stacks equal to the highest Mindlock stack count present among nearby enemies.
World in Chorus: Each stack increases the DMG Multiplier of Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence by 3%. World in Chorus is removed after casting Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence.

The Gathered Mind effect of Inherent Skill - Sea of Thought, World of Dust now inflicts 2 stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 4: Wherever the Road Leads, Side by Side
resonanceChains.details: After a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting, that Resonator's ATK is increased by 20% for 8s.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 5: Cold Steel That Longs to Warm the Snow
resonanceChains.details:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement is increased by 100%.

While moving in Sword Flight, Flight Qi cost is reduced by 30%.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 6: Cleanse This Tarnished Age, Till All Runs Clear
resonanceChains.details:
Targets take 40% more DMG from Qingxiao's Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven, and Juque Perdition.

During Heavy Attack - Stringblade, gain Exorcising Seal stacks equal to the highest Mindlock stack count present among nearby enemies.

For each stack of Mindlock on the target, the DMG of Juque Perdition taken by the target is Amplified by 2%. The first 7 stack additionally grant 5% DMG Amplification.

When Inherent Skill - To Know, To Banish is unlocked, the DMG of Juque Perdition on targets with Mindlock is increased by 2% for each stack of Mindlock. The first 7 stacks additionally grant 5% DMG increase.

The effect of Qingxiao's response to Tune Strain - Interfered is increased by 20%.

forteCircuitAttacks.description:
Zephyr Stance
Suisui is in Zephyr Stance by default. When in Zephyr Stance, Suisui can obtain Cloud Breath through certain skills.

Drizzle Stance
Entering Drizzle Stance clears all Floral Epistle.
During Drizzle Stance:
- Suisui unlocks new combat moves and restores Floral Epistle through certain skills.
-Suisui gains increased resistance to interruption.
- Press Normal Attack within a certain time after triggering a successful Dodge via Dodge skills to cast Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 1.
After entering Drizzle Stance for 15s, Suisui ends Drizzle Stance and clears all Floral Epistle upon exiting the state.

Dodge - Parting Mist
While performing attacks on the ground, press Dodge to cast Dodge - Parting Mist at the cost of STA.
When in Zephyr Stance, triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores Cloud Breath. Press Normal Attack shortly after triggering the Dodge to cast Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance.
- When in Drizzle Stance, triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores Floral Epistle, and does not reset the cycle of Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance within a certain period.

Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance
When in Drizzle Stance, Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance is replaced with Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance.
Press Normal Attack repeatedly to perform up to 4 consequtive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Floral Epistle on hit.
When casting Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 3, continuously pull in nearby targets.
Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 4 inflicts Glacio Chafe 1 time on the target on hit.

Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG, and restoring Floral Epistle on hit.

Illuminating Dew
When in Drizzle Stance, keep holding Normal Attack after casting Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance to cast this skill.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Swallow's Cut
When in Drizzle Stance, cast this skill one of the following ways:
- Release the Normal Attack button while casting Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance.
- Press Normal Attack while Suisui is mid-air.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Cloud Breath
Max 120 points.
When in Zephyr Stance:
- Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance and Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance restores Cloud Breath on hit.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance restores 40 points of Cloud Breath when Suisui is the active Resonator in the team.
- Triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores 35 points of Cloud Breath.

Floral Epistle
Max 600 points.
When in Drizzle Stance:
- Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance and Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance restores Floral Epistle on hit.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance restores 100 points of Floral Epistle when Suisui is the active Resonator in the team.
- Triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores 102 points of Floral Epistle.

outroAttacks.name: Outro Skill: Rippling Waters
outroAttacks.description:
Resonators in the team gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s.

Suisui enters Roaming Transcendent when Ceaseless Landscape is active.
Suisui exits Drizzle Stance and consumes all Floral Epistle and unlocks the following effects based on the amount of Floral Epistle consumed:

0 Floral Epistle consumed:
- All nearby Resonators in the team gain Reflecting Shadows for 6s. Resonators with Reflecting Shadows have increased resistance to interruption.

At least 200 Floral Epistle consumed:
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform Plume Step for the first time 6s into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

At least 400 Floral Epistle consumed:
- During this Roaming Transcendent state, the active Resonator within theCeaseless Landscape deals more DMG if they have Reflecting Shadows. For every 1% of Suisui's Energy Regen over 200%, the Resonator's DMG dealt is increased by 0.2%, up to 12%.
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform the second Plume Step 12s into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

At least 600 Floral Epistle consumed:
- When Suisui performs the first Plume Step, all nearby active Resonators in the team within theCeaseless Landscape gain the following effects for 24s:
Casting Outro Skill grants the incoming Resonator Undulating Mist. When Resonators with Undulating Mist consume Negative Status or Electro Rage stacks on the target, they gain an ATK increase: For every 0.12% of Suisui's Energy Regen over 200%, the Resonator's ATK is increased by 0.1% for 6s, up to 50%. Undulating Mist lasts for 14s or until the Resonator is switched off the field. When Undulating Mist is removed, the ATK increase effect is also removed.
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform the third Plume Step 18s into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

Roaming Transcendent
Lasts for 30s.
During Roaming Transcendent, Suisui will merge with Ceaseless Landscape and start a Transcendent Dance, during which she will perform Plume Steps at interval based on the amount of Floral Epistle consumed when Outro Skill - Rippling Waters is cast.
When Suisui is the active Resonator in the team, she stops the Transcendent Dance.
When Ceaseless Landscape isn't active, she will exit the Roaming Transcendent state.

Plume Step
Performing Plume Step grants Reflecting Shadows to all nearby Resonators in the team for 6s, inflicts 1 stack of Glacio Chafe on all enemies within the Ceaseless Landscape, and heals the nearby active Resonators in the team within the Ceaseless Landscape.

liberationAttacks.description:
Resonance Liberation - Netrunner
Lucy deep dives into cyberspace and pulls up the Protocol Interface for 10s. While the Protocol Interface is active, choose up to 7 different Spoofing Program effects, each requiring different RAM costs. Lucy starts with 24 points of RAM.
While in the Protocol Interface, Lucy marks targets within a certain range in her view. Marked targets will be applied with all Spoofing Program effects selected afterwards. Adjust Lucy's view to mark more targets. When no target is in view, no Spoofing Program can be applied.
While in the Protocol Interface, when either the duration expires or when Normal Attack is held down, Override is triggered, which deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets before closing the Protocol Interface, considered Heavy Attack DMG. When RAM runs out or is insufficient to activate any Spoofing Programs, press Normal Attack to trigger Override on all marked targets.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Spoofing Program: Ping
Requires 2 RAM. Extends field of view. Lucy marks and deals Spectro DMG to all nearby targets within the effective range without having to adjust the view, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction
Requires 4 RAM. Marked targets take 5% more DMG for 30s.
Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol
Requires 4 RAM. Marked targets' DEF is reduced by 5% for 30s.
Spoofing Program: Synapse Burnout
Requires 5 RAM. Deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets within a certain range, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement
Requires 6 RAM. Deals Hack DMG to all marked targets and reduces their ATK by 5% for 30s.
Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch
Requires 5 RAM. Causes all marked targets' attacks to have a chance to be reduced by 100% within 30s.
Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis
Requires 6 RAM. Convert all marked targets to neutral units and reduce their Vibration Strength. Only effective against Common Class enemies.

Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive
When in Algorithm Compaction, after Heavy Attack - Multi-threading is cast, Resonance Liberation - Netrunner is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive. Lucy gains all effects of Resonance Liberation - Netrunner, and the DMG Multiplier of Override is greatly increased.
After casting Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive, or when Lucy exits the Algorithm Compaction state, Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Netrunner.
