Algorithm Compaction
After casting Resonance Skill - Deadlock, Lucy enters Algorithm Compaction and gains 1 stack of SQL. Her Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, and Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Lucy's Spectro DMG Bonus is increased by 65% for 8s.
While in Algorithm Compaction, casting Resonance Skill - Deadlock again will not grant SQL and Spectro DMG Bonus repetitively.
When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy gains Root Access upon hitting a target with attacks including Basic Attack - Thread Shredding and Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Reaching 100 points of Root Access replaces Heavy Attack - Single Threading with Heavy Attack - Dual Threading. Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack - Dual Threading to cast Heavy Attack - Multi-threading.
When casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, if Lucy has SQL, increase this attack's DMG Multiplier by 270% and remove SQL.
When casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, if Lucy does not have SQL, she loses 20% of current HP. If Lucy's HP is below 1%, no HP is consumed.
After casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, Resonance Liberation - Netrunner is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive.
Lucy exits the the Algorithm Compaction state after casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive, or Heavy Attack - Multi-threading is not followed up by one of these skills: Normal Attack - Locked Thread, Resonance Skill - Protocol Breach, Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination, and Tune Break - Data Crash.

liberationAttacks.name: Resonance Liberation: Party 'til Dawn!
liberationAttacks.description:
Switching to Mk. 31 HMG mode generates a field of Stagnation for 9.5s, in which:
Rebecca fires the Mk. 31 HMG automatically, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, while accumulating Overload. Press or hold Normal Attack or press Resonance Liberation at intervals after Rebecca starts firing to enhance her Mk. 31 HMG's firepower and accumulate Overload faster. This effect can be triggered up to 2 times.
- The machine gun will only auto-lock onto the enemy closest to the crosshair in the aim down sight.
- Rebecca is immobile when firing the Mk. 31 HMG and gains 50% DMG Reduction and Immunity to Interrruption.

Overload
Rebecca can hold up to 90 points of Overload.
Hitting targets with the standard firepower Mk. 31 HMG grants 2 points.
Hitting targets with the enhanced firepower Mk. 31 HMG grants 4 points.
Hitting targets with the twice-enhanced firepower Mk. 31 HMG grants 6 points.

BOOM! Fireworks!
After Mk. 31 HMG mode ends or when Overload is maxed, BOOM! Fireworks! is automatically cast, dealing Electro DMG. Casting BOOM! Fireworks! ends Mk. 31 HMG.
- Hold Resonance Liberation while in Mk. 31 HMG mode to immediatly cast BOOM! Fireworks!.
- Leaving the Mk. 31 HMG mode removes all Overload.

forteCircuitAttacks.name: Forte Circuit: Gloves Are Comin' Off!
forteCircuitAttacks.description:
Switch Gears!
Upon casting Resonance Skill or Intro Skill, Rebecca can freely switch between the Huntress and Guts modes.
- The Huntress mode increases Rebecca's Crit. DMG by 30%.
- The Guts mode allows Rebecca to ignore 15% of the target's DEF.
By default, Rebecca starts in the Huntress mode.

Hack - Shifting
Rebecca inflicts Hack - Shifting upon dealing damage to the targets through the following skills. The same skill can trigger this effect once every 3s:
Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress, Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, and Resonance Liberation - BOOM! Fireworks!.

Hack Response - Meltdown
Deal Electro DMG to all targets affected by Hack - Interfered within the range, considered Hack DMG.

Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress
At 120 points of Fervor, Heavy Attack - Huntress is replaced with Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress. Hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress, which consumes all Fervor to pull in nearby targets and deal Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
During Heavy Attack - Huntress, if Fervor is at 120 points and Rebecca is not in the action of Tactical Dodge - Huntress, release Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress.

Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts
At 120 points of Fervor, Heavy Attack - Guts is replaced with Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts. Hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, which consumes all Fervor to pull in nearby targets and deal Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

Fervor
Rebecca can hold up to 120 points of Fervor.
Normal Attacks restore Fervor upon damaging the target.
Resonance Skill restores Fervor upon damaging the target.
When A Girl Gets What She Wants! is gained by casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time! or Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Rebecca restores 50 points of Fervor.

Hot Hand
Rebecca can hold up to 120 points of Hot Hand.
Regenerates over time at a rate of 10 points per second.
Casting Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts restores 40 points.

A Girl Gets What She Wants!
At 120 points of Hot Hand, casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Resonance Skill - It's Big Boomin' Time!, or Resonance Skill - Come 'n' Get Me! grants the following effects for 12s:
Rebecca simultaneously gains the Stat Bonuses of both the Huntress and Guts modes, regardless of which mode she's currently in.
Hot Hand cannot be restored during this period and is consumed by 10 points per second.

Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!
When in the Guts mode, upon casting Intro Skill, Rebecca approaches the enemy using the recoil of Guts from shooting the ground and switches to the Huntress mode to spray lead at the enemy, dealing Electro DMG.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 2: Oh, Hey Choom! - All-Attribute
resonanceChains.details:

forteCircuitAttacks.description:
Erosion Field
After casting Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form, generate an Erosion Field, lasting for 30s. Only one Erosion Field generated by your own Resonator can exist at a time.
Erosion Field pulls in nearby targets once every 4s, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.

Void Particle
When in the Breakdown Form while holding Void Particle, Normal Attack consumes Void Particle on hit and grants the following effects:
- The skill DMG is considered Resonance Liberation DMG and the DMG Multiplier is increased by 50%.
- Conformal Charge regenerates 100% faster.

Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst
While in Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, Denia gains the following effects:
- Each time when the following skills deal damage, inflict 2 stacks of Fusion Burst on the target. The same skill can only trigger this effect once every 2s against the same target.

- Each time when the following skills deal damage, inflict Fusion Burst on the target. The same skill can only trigger this effect once every 2s against the same target.
Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4, Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3, and Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4.
- When Denia is in the team, if an enemy falls to Fusion Burst DMG, it counts as caused by the nearest active Resonator.

Resonance Mode - Tune Strain
While in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, Denia gains the following effects:
- Each time when the following skills deal damage, inflict Tune Strain - Shifting on the target and reset the duration of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target. The same skill can only trigger this effect once every 2s against the same target.
Intro Skill It's Been A While!, Intro Skill Knock Knock, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Stagecraft Form, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form, Erosion Field, Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4, Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3 and Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4.

basicAttacks.name: Normal Attack: One, Two, Three
basicAttacks.description:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
Enter Decipher state for 5s after casting Basic Attack Stage 4. This effect ends early if Sigrika is switched off the field.
When Sigrika has at least 50 points of Full Stop, her Basic Attack cycle starts from Stage 2.

Basic Attack - Elucidated
In the Decipher state, press Normal Attack on the ground to cast Basic Attack - Elucidated, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the Decipher state upon casting this skill.

Heavy Attack
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Plunging Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Dodge Counter
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge on the ground to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Dodge Counter to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.

Dodge Counter - Decipher
In the Decipher state, press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge on the ground to cast Dodge Counter - Decipher to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the Decipher state upon casting this skill.

Mid-air Dodge Counter
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge in mid-air to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Mid-air Dodge Counter to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

skillAttacks.name: Resonance Skill: Royan Close Quarters Combat
skillAttacks.description:
BOOMY BOOM!
Attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting BOOMY BOOM! to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

BIG BOOMY BOOM!
While in the Decipher state, press Resonance Skill on the ground to cast BIG BOOMY BOOM!, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the Decipher state upon casting this skill.

Soliskin to the Aid
While in the Decipher state, with at least 50 points of Full Stop, press Resonance Skill on the ground to cast Soliskin to the Aid, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the Decipher state upon casting this skill.

liberationAttacks.name: Resonance Liberation: Where Trust Leads Me!
liberationAttacks.description:
Deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG). Gain Divergent for 20s.

Divergent
The next time Sigrika obtains a Rune, she additionally obtains a Rune of the opposite type and removes Divergent. When Sigrika holds Divergent and Convergent at the same time, Convergent takes priority. When Sigrika holds 100 points of Full Stop, Divergent doesn't take effect.

forteCircuitAttacks.name: Forte Circuit: Within Infinity's Embrace
forteCircuitAttacks.description:
Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes
Hold Normal Attack to consume two Runes and cast Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes, dealing Aero DMG. Based on the types of the Runes consumed, Sigrika gains the following effects:
- When consuming Rune: Trust and Rune: Answer, this skill gains the effect of Runic Outburst.
- When consuming two Runes: Trust, this skill gains the effect of Runic Chain Whip.
- When consuming two Runes: Answer, this skill gains the effect of Runic Soliskin.
When consuming Runes, if Sigrika holds at least 30 points of Soliskin Vitality, consume 30 points to increase the DMG Multipliers of the current Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, and Runic Soliskin by 50%. Obtain a stack of Innate Gift?.
When consuming Runes, if Soliskin Vitality is lower than 30 points, consume all Soliskin Vitality. Every 10 points of Soliskin Vitality consumed grants the current Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, and Runic Soliskin 15% DMG Amplification.
Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes deals Echo Skill DMG.

Runic Outburst
Deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Runic Chain Whip
Stagnate nearby targets and deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Runic Soliskin
Pull in nearby targets and deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name
When Full Stop reaches 100 points, if Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name is not on Cooldown, press Resonance Skill to cast Resonance Skill - BOOMY BOOM! or Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid. Hold Resonance Skill to consume all Full Stop to cast Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Innate Gift?
Sigrika can hold up to 2 stacks of Innate Gift?. Each stack grants Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin and Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name 30% DMG Amplification.
This effect ends after Sigrika casts Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name or is switched off the field.

Rune
Sigrika holds up to 4 Runes. Without Full Stop, Sigrika can only hold up to 2 Runes. When Sigrika gains a new Rune at max capacity, the existing Runes shift one slot to the left, removing the leftmost Rune. With at least 50 points of Full Stop, Sigrika can hold 2 additional Runes.
Hitting a target with Basic Attack - Elucidated or Dodge Counter - Decipher grants one Rune: Trust.
Hitting a target with Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM! or Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid grants one Rune: Answer.

Full Stop
After casting Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes, gain 50 points of Full Stop.

Soliskin Vitality
When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains 10 points of Soliskin Vitality, up to 60 points. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. Casting Outro Skill - In This Very Moment resets the record of Echo triggering this effect.
